subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A new tool often solves an old problem while creating new rules.”?
options: A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.
It is testing whether people can be honest when no one gives them an exact number.
The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.
The question is not only whether something is smart, but whether the people using it are prepared.
